Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP)

United States
Checked 2026-08-14

SNAP provides food benefits to low-income families to supplement their grocery budget so they can afford nutritious food. This directory connects individuals to their local state agency to apply for benefits.

  • Food
CostFree resource finder.

The program provides food benefits at no cost to eligible low-income households.

AccessOfficial online locator
Open listing
Hours, location & verification
Coverage
Nationwide online directory covering all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Guam, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands

Check before you go. Eligibility is based on income and resources, and requirements vary by state. Applicants must contact their local SNAP office to apply.
